name: Money Nose – More Enquiries From Your Website
author: moneynose

sections.description:
Money Nose finds what is stopping your website from bringing in enquiries and sales. It puts the fixes in order of their estimated value. This plugin makes the changes you approve in Money Nose.

Each change is recorded, with the old wording saved. You can undo it from Changes in Money Nose while the page has not been edited again.

What it can change, only after you approve each change:

  • Page titles and descriptions for search results, using Yoast SEO or Rank Math if installed.
  • Image descriptions, also called alt text, in your posts and pages.
  • One sentence linking to another page on your website, added to an existing paragraph.
  • Broken links to your pages, corrected or removed while keeping the words.
  • A page headline, or a short piece of button or link text.
  • A page Money Nose wrote for you, saved as a draft. Publish it only with your approval, or return it to a draft.

It never deletes your pages or changes prices, products, legal pages, plugins, themes, users or settings.

Once connected, it also:

  • Counts page visits, including people who block browser scripts. Daily totals stay on your website for two weeks.
  • Leaves out editors, known non-human visits, unpublished page views and excluded visits.
  • Counts visits and enquiry actions without cookies.
  • Sends WooCommerce sales figures without customer names or contact details.

You need a Money Nose account. Nothing is sent until connected. Your website figures and any Google data you connect help Money Nose suggest improvements.

External services

Money Nose

This plugin connects your website to the Money Nose service at https://moneynose.com.
Nothing is sent when you install or activate the plugin. Sending starts when you paste your connection code and press Connect.

What is sent, and when:

  • On connection: your site address, its connection address, site identifier, WordPress and plugin versions, and whether you use Yoast SEO or Rank Math. This checks the connection.
  • Hourly while connected: daily visits and page views for today and yesterday, by page. No visitor IP addresses or cookies.
  • Daily while connected: your site identifier and plugin version, to check the connection.
  • When reading a page for a proposed change: its relevant content and settings.
  • When you approve or undo a change: its details and result. Old values are saved for undo.
  • On disconnect or deletion: your site identifier and action chosen. Disconnect also sends the plugin version.

With WooCommerce active, the plugin sends these figures every hour:

  • Daily paid order totals, orders on hold, refunds and currency.
  • Sales after discounts and refunds, excluding tax and shipping.
  • Product identifiers, names, quantities and sales totals, plus how many orders used a coupon.
  • Where customers first arrived from and their landing pages, as recorded by WooCommerce.
  • Order numbers, payment references, amounts and payment times, so the same payment is not counted twice.

Customer names, emails, phone numbers and addresses are not sent. Text that looks like an email, phone number or long number is removed from product names, sources and page paths before sending.

The first sales import covers 60 days. Later updates normally cover the last 14 days and older orders changed recently, such as late refunds, up to 60 days back.

After connection, the plugin loads Money Nose’s browser script for people who are not signed in:

  • It sends page addresses, where visits came from, campaign labels and screen width when a page is viewed.
  • It sends form submissions and phone, email, WhatsApp or booking clicks, without form contents.
  • Enquiry actions include time since the page opened and whether the visitor interacted with it.
  • It sends time on a page and how far down it was read. A fresh random code links these readings for that page view only.
  • If you enable the question about how visitors found you, it sends their chosen answer.
  • It receives settings for the features you enable and sends counts for approved page changes.

This shows visits, enquiries and results without cookies or lasting visitor identifiers. Network addresses are received but not stored in visitor records.

Money Nose terms of service: https://moneynose.com/terms
Money Nose privacy policy: https://moneynose.com/privacy

Google data connected in Money Nose

The plugin does not connect directly to Google. In your Money Nose account, you can separately authorise Google connections:

  • Google Analytics supplies website visit and enquiry figures.
  • Google Search Console supplies search terms, pages, appearances in search results, clicks and page indexing information.
  • Google Ads supplies campaign, search term, spending, click and sales or enquiry figures if you connect it.

Money Nose reads this data on connection and during scheduled updates to show figures and suggest improvements. Disconnect in Money Nose Settings.

Google terms of service: https://policies.google.com/terms
Google privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

For developers

  • The connection address is the WordPress REST API address under money-nose/v1. HTTPS server requests use HMAC-SHA256 with a per-site key. Timestamps outside five minutes and reused request codes are rejected.
  • Scheduled sends use WP-Cron. The plugin contacts /api/wp/connect, /api/wp/counts, /api/wp/sales and /api/wp/lifecycle on moneynose.com.
  • The script loads from https://moneynose.com/t.js and sends to https://moneynose.com/api/t. It reports the presence of advertising click codes, not their values. Browser storage only records the owner’s browser exclusion.
  • Google OAuth access is separate. Analytics and Search Console permissions are read-only. Google Ads needs separate authorisation. This plugin stores no Google access credentials.
sections.installation:
1. Create a free Money Nose account at https://moneynose.com.
  2. In WordPress, go to Plugins, Add New and search for Money Nose. Choose Install, then Activate.
  3. In Money Nose, go to Settings and copy the WordPress connection code.
  4. In WordPress, go to Settings, Money Nose. Paste the code and press Connect.

If you cannot search for plugins, upload money-nose.zip under Plugins, Add New, Upload Plugin, then activate it.

Step-by-step help: https://moneynose.com/help/installing/wordpress
sections.faq:
Does Money Nose change my website on its own?

No. It only makes a change after you approve it in Money Nose. You can undo it while the page has not been edited again.

What does the plugin send to Money Nose?

Once connected, it sends visit, enquiry and sales figures, connection details and page change information. See External services for the full list and conditions.

Does it work with Yoast SEO or Rank Math?

Yes. Search titles and descriptions are saved in the plugin you use. Otherwise, Money Nose adds them while this plugin is active.

Can it publish pages?

Only a page Money Nose wrote for you, and only after you approve it in Money Nose. Until then it stays an unpublished draft.

What happens if I remove the plugin?

  • Before removing it, choose whether to undo Money Nose’s changes or keep them.
  • Changes you keep stay on your website. Money Nose cannot undo them after removal.
  • Some search titles and descriptions need the plugin to stay active.
  • Deleting the plugin removes its connection details. Undo records stay unless you have undone the changes or chosen to keep them.
sections.changelog:
1.3.4

  • Clearer WordPress.org description, setup steps and screenshot captions.
  • A dismissible note asking for an honest review after your first approved change.
  • Undo or keep changes before disconnecting in WordPress or Money Nose Settings.
  • Undo records stay unless you have undone the changes or chosen to keep them.
  • Connection messages explain what to do next.
  • Adds visit and enquiry counting after connection, without editing your website files.
  • Daily checks keep quiet websites connected.

1.3.3

  • Fixing a broken link changes only that link, even if the same words appear elsewhere.
  • If no suitable page is found, the link is removed and its words stay. Undo restores that link.

1.3.2

  • Safer handling of visit information. Visit counting stays the same.

1.3.1

  • Safer handling of stored visit counts. No change to how the plugin works.

1.3.0

  • Sends WooCommerce sales figures, including refunds and recent order updates.
  • Customer names and contact details are not sent.

1.2.0

  • Counts visits even when people block browser scripts.
  • Sends daily page totals without visitor IP addresses or cookies.
  • Leaves out editors, known non-human visits, unpublished page views and excluded visits.

1.1.0

  • Apply an approved headline or button text change, with undo.
  • Save pages Money Nose writes as drafts. Publish only with your approval, or return them to drafts.

1.0.0

  • First release.
